text:
morgan: Quick ask — want to provision a compact GPU nodepool in asia-southeast1 for lightweight inference (low-latency text scoring). Target load: ~50 concurrent tiny pods. Looking for advice on instance type, autoscaler settings, and quotas. Can we do a preemptible-heavy mix? :thinking_face:
sasha: what's the per-pod resource request (cpu/mem/gpu)? that drives node sizing. also are you planning MIG or 1:1 gpu pods?
morgan: pods are small — 0.5 vCPU, 1GB mem, single inference process. Ideally we pack multiple pods per GPU via MPS/worker multiplexing instead of 1:1 gpu. Prefer a node with 1 GPU and 4 CPU to get density. Thinking something like an a2-highgpu-1g / a10g equivalent.
sasha: note: fractional GPUs require MIG (NVIDIA A100/A30). a10g doesn't support MIG. if you're relying on MPS, it's user-land — ok but has perf variability. safer to schedule nvidia.com/gpu:1 per model server and rely on small images to reduce memory.
jules: quota check — current GPU quota in ap-southeast1 is ~40 GPUs used, we have ~12 free. If we want a pool with 10 nodes (1 GPU each) we'll hit quota. need a cloud quota request. I can kick that off but need exact SKU.
morgan: thanks — plan is initially max 8 nodes (so 8 GPUs). machine type: prefer a10g-standard-1 (4vCPU, 1 GPU). If quota request needed, what SKU string should I include?
jules: include A100/A10G GPU SKU depending on provider, but in request say "A10G-equivalent GPUs in asia-southeast1" and ask for +16 to be safe. include project id and region. I can add account owner.
kevin: autoscaler notes: recommend CA settings: minNodes=0, maxNodes=8, expander=least-waste (or priority), balance-similar-node-groups=true, scale-down-unneeded-time=10m. set scale-down-unready-time and exclude daemonset pods from utilization calc. also pin node taint so only inference pods schedule. snippet:
```yaml
nodePool: 
  name: inference-compact-apse1
  machineType: a10g-standard-1
  minSize: 0
  maxSize: 8
  taints:
    - key: gpu
      value: reserved
      effect: NoSchedule
  labels:
    role: inference
```
kevin: also set PodDisruptionBudget low and use priorityClass for canary vs bulk traffic.
neha: watch egress NAT IPs — ap-southeast1 NAT has strict IP limit for our account (8). bursting 50 concurrent pods may hit SNAT port exhaustion if many connections. either use multiple NAT IPs (request more) or add NAT per node pool with ephemeral external IPs. for internal model scoring that calls only internal services, add private routes to avoid NAT.
morgan: good call. most inference calls are to internal embedding cache + model server, but health checks talk to metrics endpoint over internet. I'll route metrics into VPC and remove external egress.
sasha: also remember device-plugin version and kernel module on images. use our baked GPU base image with nvidia-driver 535 and device-plugin v1.11. add preflight DaemonSet for driver + busybox check.
morgan: here's a quick terraform node_pool block I'm drafting, feel free to nit:
```hcl
resource "redwood_node_pool" "inference_compact_apse1" {
  name        = "inference-compact-apse1"
  region      = "asia-southeast1"
  machine     = "a10g-standard-1"
  min_size    = 0
  max_size    = 8
  preemptible = true
  taints = {"gpu" = "reserved:NoSchedule"}
  labels = {"role" = "inference"}
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot created a preflight ticket #INF-4321 for nodepool 'inference-compact-apse1' with assignee @jules.
jules: noted, will attach quota request and owner. also schedule a maintenance window for node image test.
kevin: small reminder — set node-pool autoscaling cooldown to avoid flapping with short-lived bursts. set scale-up-delay ~30s and scale-down-delay ~10m.
neha: for cost — preemptible mix is good, but ensure graceful fallback to non-preemptible for SLO-critical routes. configure cluster routing policy to fall back to dedicated pool on OOM/evictions.
morgan: thanks all. I'll open the TF PR with the snippet, file the quota request (asking for +16 GPUs), and plan a small canary (1 node) to validate driver + MPS behavior. assigning to @sasha for review and @jules for quota. :rocket: :thumbsup:
